welcome_npc: Hey! Welcome to the Tower of Code!
Up north stand three towers, one per chapter: The Basics in the woods, Data & Loops in the caves, Advanced in the citadel.
Each floor is a chapter of the Python course, and its trainers won't let you through without a battle.
Beat the boss at the top of a tower and the next tower opens. Read the signs if you're lost!
Want to warm up first? The road west leads to the Training Hall.
hint_npc_01: Hey there! I'm also a student here.
Tip: Variables can store different types of data - numbers, text, and more!
Good luck with the Professor's challenge!
gatekeeper_blocked: Complete all the challenges on this map before moving on.
trainer_battle_intro: You there! Let's see what you know!
prof_pi_battle: Welcome to the Training Maze! I'm Professor Pi.
Every trainer here will test what you know. Beat them with your knowledge, not your fists!
Let's start with the basics: variables. Zap, you're up!
trainer_defeated: You beat me fair and square! Keep practicing and you'll climb this tower in no time.
trainer_content_missing: Hmm... my challenge seems to have disappeared from the course. (Content error: please tell the developer!)
tower_prof_lesson: Here's what you need to know before facing the trainers of this floor.
tower_prof_review: No new lesson here: the trainers will test everything you've learned so far. Good luck!
tower_guardian: You want the stairs? You'll have to beat me first!
tower_final: So you climbed the whole tower... I'm impressed!
I've taught you everything I know. One last battle: show me what you've learned!
tower_ending: Before you go, let me say a few last words.
sign_act1: Floors in the woods. At the top: Boole, master of true and false.
sign_act2: Floors in the caves. At the top: Lovelace. Opens once Boole is beaten.
sign_act3: Floors in the citadel. At the top: Prof Pi himself. Opens once Lovelace is beaten.
sign_training: Practice battles and puzzles, at your own pace. Optional!
sign_village: North: the three towers. West: the Training Hall.
boss_boole: So you made it through the woods...
I am Boole. Everything here is true or false, and so is your victory. Let's find out!
boss_boole_beaten: True! You really did beat me.
The portal behind me leads to Chapter 2 · Data & Loops. Keep climbing!
boss_lovelace: Welcome to the bottom of the caves. I am Lovelace.
I wrote the first program ever written. Show me you can loop like I did!
boss_lovelace_beaten: Remarkable... the student has become the programmer.
The portal behind me leads to Chapter 3 · Advanced. The top isn't far now!
tv_bedroom: On TV, kids head off on an adventure with their CODÉMON...
console_bedroom: A game console! But this is no time to play.
sink_home: The sink is spotless. The neighbour takes good care of it.
sign_town0: Where everything starts with a print().
town_girl: Have you seen the TOWER OF CODE? They say each floor is harder than the last!
town_kid: PROF. PI says a good trainer always reads the error message to the end.
town_fisher: The sea is calm today. Perfect for thinking about your code.
machine_lab: A huge machine. Lines of code scroll by at full speed!
pi_lesson_intro: PROF. PI: {player}! Nice to meet you!
PROF. PI: Here, CODÉMON battle with PYTHON code. Every right answer is an attack!
PROF. PI: First things first: let's write your very first line of code. Follow me!
pi_codedex: PROF. PI: Take this: the CODÉDEX! It keeps track of every CODÉMON you meet.
PROF. PI: There are 18 of them. Finding them all is my dream!
pi_later: PROF. PI: The TOWER OF CODE is just north, {player}. Good luck!
PROF. PI: In battle, every right answer is an attack. Every mistake, a hit taken!
blackout: {player} has no strength left to code!
pi_welcome: PROF. PI: Ah, there you are! Welcome to my lab, at the foot of the TOWER OF CODE!
PROF. PI: I'm PROF. PI. And this is ZAP, my CODÉMON.
pi_name_ask: PROF. PI: And you, what's your name?
pi_which_codemon: PROF. PI: Well done! At the end, you chose a CODÉMON in your code...
PROF. PI: So, which one did you pick?
pi_egg: PROF. PI: Perfect! Look at this egg: it listened to your whole lesson...
pi_test_battle: PROF. PI: Let's see what you two can do!
PROF. PI: A little practice battle: ZAP, go! Answer right to attack, {player}!
pi_battle_won: PROF. PI: Excellent! You beat ZAP on your first try!
pi_battle_lost: PROF. PI: Not bad at all for a first battle! With a bit of practice, you'll go far.
pi_go_tower: PROF. PI: The TOWER OF CODE is just north of town. Each floor is a chapter of PYTHON!
PROF. PI: If {starter} gets tired, come back to the lab: my assistant will heal it.
aide_heal: ASSISTANT: Your CODÉMON look tired? I'll take care of them!
aide_healed: ASSISTANT: There you go, they're in top shape!
ASSISTANT: If you ever faint, you'll wake up here, at the lab.
table_lab: "Eggs hatch when you talk to them in PYTHON. Fascinating!"
sign_tower: One floor, one chapter of PYTHON. At the very top: the end of the course!
neighbour_talk: NEIGHBOUR: Hello, {player}! My grandson codes all day long, upstairs.
NEIGHBOUR: He says that in PYTHON, a line starting with # is a comment: the computer ignores it!
student_talk: STUDENT: I'm studying for the TOWER OF CODE!
STUDENT: The secret is to read the error message to the end. It almost always tells you where the problem is.
hall_reception: RECEPTION: Welcome to the TOWER OF CODE!
RECEPTION: The stairs at the back lead to floor 1. Each floor teaches a chapter of PYTHON.
RECEPTION: Good news: every time you reach a floor, your CODÉMON is back in top shape. Enjoy the climb!
hall_elevator: An elevator. It isn't running yet...
hall_banner: The banner reads: "One floor, one chapter. Code, nothing but code."
